en: Conditioned by a state that is neither unwholesome nor leading to liberation, a state that is wholesome and leading to liberation arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor leading to liberation, a state that is indeterminate and not leading to liberation arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor leading to liberation, a state that is indeterminate and not leading to liberation arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on unwholesome and non-leading states, and dependent on indeterminate and non-leading states, an indeterminate and non-leading state arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. There are three under root; three under predominance ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
